text:
```yaml
name: Codex Review Notify Code Owner

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - epic
      - develop

jobs:
  codex-review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v2
      with:
        node-version: '16'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm install

    - name: Run Vitest coverage
      run: npx vitest run --coverage

    - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
      uses: codecov/codecov-action@v2
      with:
        file: ./coverage/lcov.info
        flags: unittests
        name: ${{ github.ref }}
        fail_ci_if_error: true

    - name: Notify code owner
      id: notify_code_owner
      uses: peter-evans/codeowners-action@v2
      with:
        comment: "Please review the changes made by @${{ github.actor }}"
        labels: "review needed"
        assignees: "${{ github.actor }}"

    - name: Check if notification was successful
      if: steps.notify_code_owner.outcome == 'success'
      run: echo "Code owner notification sent successfully."
    - name: Check if notification failed
      if: steps.notify_code_owner.outcome == 'failure'
      run: echo "Failed to send code owner notification."
```
